mechanism: Stage complete unchanged BF16 input for min(M,3) rows in CTA-owned shared memory before the existing LUT barrier. Use128-bit coalesced publication, unchanged64-bit shared reads in the K loop; M4 final row keeps native global load/prefetch. Packed weight loads and weight prefetch remain native. Fixed6144-row stride fits K5120/6144; set maximum shared carveout to admit incumbent register-limited CTA counts.
equivalence: Pure bit-preserving input storage transfer. Same K subsequences, FP32 FMA chains, scalar weight decoding, complete live warp/block reduction, global scale and BF16 publication. No projection reassociation, packed-weight shared ring or inner CTA rendezvous. Inputs remain immutable through launch; publication is CTA-private and the existing full-CTA LUT barrier releases all consumers.
reference: Transfer existing retained NV Gate input residency to FP8 as an upfront operand-publication schedule. FP8 has no extra intra-CTA activation reuse claim: the benefit hypothesis is demand-load placement/vector width, with extra shared movement charged to API. Prior FP32 global activation expansion and compressed-weight asynchronous pipelines are distinct and remain closed. Existing Marlin cooperative operand staging is reference only; no imports or dependencies.
